jobs.title: EME Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

* **Introduction:** A position as EME System Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space in Getafe (Madrid).

* **Brief description of the department’s mission** :

  

The selected candidate will join the TADYX1 Team in charge of managing the disciplines of electromagnetic protection for aircraft structures and systems and antenna integration.

The candidate will be part of multicultural and multidisciplinary team working in different military programs under our product portfolio, reinforcing the team in or der to ensure the implementation of complex design solutions within different challenging military projects, covering all the complete development V cycle: from customer/airworthiness requirements capture to aircraft certification, aircraft delivery and in-service aircraft support.

**SKILLS**

  

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

  

*-* **Education:**

Degree in Telecommunication Engineering, Aeronautical, Electrical Engineering or Physics

* **Experience:**

At least 5 years in Engineering with strong background in electromagnetism theory, electromagnetic protection measures applied to aircraft structures and systems/equipment and aircraft design.

Knowledge about integration at platform level (complete cycle: specification, validation, verification, certification/qualification).

User of complex and advanced tools for electromagnetic simulation and modelling for EME design and antenna integration (CST, FEKO, etc,..). CAD management, computational tools and postprocessing.

Good Technical skills, familiar with R/T and R&D projects.

Ability to work autonomously as well as being active part of a team.

Ability to overcome difficulties in the development of the projects.

Knowledge of applicable standard and regulation for EME equipment qualification and aircraft certification (e.g. DO-160, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, CS/FAR25, etc,…).

* **Soft skills** : High adaptability to work on new topics, new business and in a networking mode.

*-* **Languages:** Advanced level in English.

*-* **Technical knowledge** : programming in C#, advanced level of CATIA, Matlab, …

  

**WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?**

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

* Vacation days and additional days-off along the year (+35 days off in total)
* Attractive salary and compensation package
* Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance
* Collective transport service in some sites
* Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan...
* On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office
* Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives
* Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment
Special rates in products & benefits  

  

**WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT US?**

Airbus is a leader in designing, manufacturing and delivering aerospace products, services and solutions to customers on a worldwide scale, pioneering sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world.

With around 130,000 employees and as the largest aeronautics and space company in Europe and a worldwide leader, Airbus is at the forefront of the aviation industry, connecting people and places via air and space.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

  

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**Company:**

Airbus Defence and Space SAU

**Employment Type:**

Permanent

Professional

Elec.Electron.&Electromag,Optics&Optron. <JF-EN-ED>

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com .

jobs.title: Ingeniero software senior
jobs.description:
**¿Quiénes somos?**
===================

En Solusoft, con más de 30 años de experiencia desarrollando soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras, seguimos creciendo con nuevos proyectos y grandes retos.

Buscamos un **Ingeniero de Software Senior** para diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar soluciones escalables, seguras y eficientes.

**Ingenier@ de Software Senior**
--------------------------------

* Realizar y documentar el diseño técnico del proyecto.
* Asegurar la implantación y seguimiento de los estándares de desarrollo, buenas prácticas y patrones de diseño definidos.
* Participar del desarrollo del proyecto, liderar y acompañar técnicamente al equipo.
* Participar en la evaluación de nuevas tecnologías y herramientas para mejorar la eficiencia y seguridad
* Asegurar la correcta integración de sistemas y aplicaciones.
* Implementar pruebas de calidad, testing y despliegue automático.

**Requisitos**
--------------

* +5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de soluciones de software sobre tecnologías .NET.
* Experiencia en desarrollo de Webs y APIs.
* Conocimiento en Azure / AWS / Google Cloud (preferencia por Azure).
* Experiencia en Microservicios, Docker, Kubernetes.
* Conocimiento en bases de datos SQL y NoSQL
* Experiencia en CI / CD y DevOps (Github / Gitlab).
* Habilidades de liderazgo y comunicación.
* Conocimientos para la definición y ejecución de pruebas de seguridad y carga.

**Valoramos**
-------------

* Conocimientos en Scrum, Kanban.
* Certificaciones en arquitectura de software o tecnologías relacionadas.
* Experiencia con Kafka, RabbitMQ.

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**
-------------------

Modelo de **trabajo híbrido** +

* Al menos dos mañanas presenciales a la semana en el Parque Tecnológico de Leganés.
* El resto remoto con excelente organización y comunicación.

### **Horarios flexibles y conciliación**

Lunes a jueves: 08:00 - 14:00 y 15:00 - 17:30.

Viernes: jornada intensiva de 08:00 - 15:00.

Una tarde libre adicional a la semana.

Jornada intensiva en verano y horarios especiales en Navidad.

### **Ambiente laboral y desarrollo profesional**

Muy buen ambiente de trabajo .

Formación continua .

Trabaja con nosotros en proyectos innovadores.

**¿Te interesa?**
-----------------

¿Buscas un lugar donde desarrollar tu talento y sentir que tu esfuerzo cuenta de verdad?

En Solusoft cada día es una oportunidad real para desarrollarte en el sector TIC. Si te motiva la tecnología, disfrutas trabajando en equipo y quieres formar parte de una empresa donde las personas están en el centro, déjanos tu CV. **¡Da el siguiente paso en tu carrera y súmate a nuestro equipo!**

**¿Dónde estamos?**
-------------------

Nos encontramos en el **Parque Tecnológico de Leganés**, al que podrás llegar en transporte público o en coche y tendrás posibilidad de aparcar con gran facilidad.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET/Angular)
jobs.description:
I'm working with an exciting software start-up in Dublin that is continuing to grow its engineering team and is looking to appoint a Senior Software Engineer.

This is a hands on role for someone who enjoys building software, improving existing systems and working closely with other engineers to deliver new product features.

The company is still at a stage where strong engineers can have a real impact, so they are looking for someone experienced who can come in, contribute quickly and help raise the technical standard of the product as it grows.

(Hybrid - Dublin City Centre - 3 days per week on-site)

The role...

You'll work across a modern .NET and Angular environment, building and improving customer facing software within a microservices based architecture.

Responsibilities...

Design, build and maintain software across backend and frontend applications
Develop new features from design through to production
Work hands-on with C#/.NET and Angular
Contribute to architecture and technical design decisions
Build and maintain REST APIs and microservices
Work with relational and NoSQL databases
Improve code quality, testing and release readiness
Use TDD and strong automated testing practices
Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to long-term fixes
Work closely with Product, QA and DevOps
Help improve performance, scalability and reliability
Contribute ideas around modernisation and technical improvement
Take ownership of work rather than simply delivering assigned tickets

Technical environment...

C#
.NET / .NET Core
Angular
REST APIs
Microservices
SQL Server / PostgreSQL
NoSQL
AWS
CI/CD
TDD
Modern automated testing practices

About you...

You'll likely be an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in .NET development and modern web applications.

You'll ideally have experience with:

C# / .NET
Angular
Microservices
REST API development
SQL databases
TDD
Unit, integration and automated testing
Modern software architecture
Cloud environments
CI/CD
Production troubleshooting
Building and shipping software products

Experience modernising legacy applications or moving monolithic systems towards more modern architectures would be particularly useful.

Why apply?

This is a great opportunity to join a growing software company at a stage where your work will be highly visible.

You'll remain close to the code, have real ownership over what you build and work directly with senior engineering leadership as the product and team continue to develop.

Negotiable salary of €80,000-€90,000 depending on experience.

To speak in absolute confidence about this opportunity, please send an up-to-date CV via the link provided or contact Calum Omand, Specialist Recruitment Consultant at MCS Group, on 015259641.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

Even if this position is not right for you, we may have others that are. Please visit MCS Group to view a wide selection of our current and exclusive roles at www.mcsgroup.jobs
